summary: Backend-only testing of Razorpay payment verification flow. Created /app/backend/tests/test_payment_verification.py with 6 tests - ALL PASSED (100%). (1) GET /api/payment-settings returns {payment_enabled: true, registration_fee: 499, razorpay_configured: true}. (2) POST /api/create-order endpoint exists, accepts schema, and reaches Razorpay (returns 500 'Authentication failed' in preview because .env keys are placeholders - expected; will work in production with real keys). (3) POST /api/verify-payment endpoint EXISTS, is properly routed (no 404/405), validates Pydantic schema (422 on missing fields), and returns 400 with clear detail 'Payment verification failed. Invalid signature.' on bad signatures. Error handling & logging improvements are visible - HTTPException is re-raised correctly rather than being swallowed by the generic Exception handler (line 175-179). (4) GET /api/payment-history returns proper structure with no MongoDB _id leaked. RCA: The original user error 'payment could not be completed' with real payment was most likely caused by signature-verification failure OR generic 500 in production; verify-payment endpoint itself is correctly implemented. The recent code changes (specific SignatureVerificationError handling + logging + HTTPException re-raise) now give the frontend a proper 400 with 'Invalid signature' detail, so users/support can act on it.
